subject: gk
question: In India, which mode of transport provide door to door services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Road transport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Road transport** provides door-to-door service, which is highly convenient for passengers and goods transport.
 
• It is the most flexible mode of transport, allowing for easy and quick access to even the remotest areas.
 
• Road transport facilitates the movement of goods and passengers within cities, towns, and rural areas, making it an essential part of the transport network.
 
• It is particularly useful for short and medium distances, where other modes of transport might not be feasible or economical.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waterways**

 
 
• Involves the transportation of goods and passengers through rivers, canals, and seas.
 
• It is cost-effective for bulk and heavy goods over long distances.
 
• However, it does not provide door-to-door service and is dependent on the availability of ports and navigable waters.
 
 
 
• **Railways**
 
 
• Facilitates the movement of large volumes of goods and passengers over long distances.
 
• It is efficient and economical for mass transit.
 
• However, railways cannot provide door-to-door service as they are limited to fixed rail routes and stations.
 
 
 
• **Airways**
 
 
• Is the fastest mode of transport for long distances.
 
• It is suitable for the transportation of passengers and high-value, low-volume goods.
 
• However, it is expensive and does not provide door-to-door service, as it is limited to airports and requires additional transport to reach final destinations.
